title: Ambient finite point fibre and successive derived Frobenius transport
statement: Fix the global finite-field and positive finite-coefficient conventions $T$ [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], with $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $A=A_{E,n}$, $n\ge1$. Let $\Gamma_A$ be final-object sections with scalar restriction along the actual constant-section ring map [def-weil-point-section-scalar-functors]. Define $\operatorname{Fib}_A= D(\Gamma_A)$ on the ambient unbounded module derived category; on the constructible full subcategory it is the finite point fibre [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Use both the original coefficient localization of universe $u+1$ and its ambient localization of universe $u+2$, and compare them by deriving the identity functor on coefficient modules, with the canonical exact-composition and right-unit comparisons. For a geometric point $z:s\to X$ set $P=Lz_A^*$ and $J_z=P\mathbin{\gg}\operatorname{Fib}_A$, using the intrinsic exact pullback [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-pullback]. Let $h=g_s$ and $U=Lh_A^*$. Define $I_N^{(1)}$ to be the finite restriction--insertion--tensor-unit transport of [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport], conjugated by this canonical localization-size comparison. For $m\ge0$ define the map $I_N^{(m)}:\operatorname{Fib}_A(N)\to\operatorname{Fib}_A(L(h^m)_A^*N)$ recursively: $I_N^{(0)}=\operatorname{Fib}_A(c_{\mathrm{id}}^{-1})$ and $I_N^{(m+1)}$ is $I_N^{(1)}$ followed by $I_{UN}^{(m)}$ and the inverse compositor identifying $L(h^m)^*Lh^*$ with $L(h^{m+1})^*$. Include the equality transport for $h^{m+1}=h\mathbin{\gg}h^m$. These are exactly the identity and composition maps of [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-square]. At positive level the one-step map is obtained from the recorded level-$n+1$ transport by matching $n$, never by choosing a new map; the zero-level branch is eliminated by $1\le n$.

def graphPointTransportPower (T : TraceFormulaCoefficientConventions.{u}) :
    (m : ℕ) → (N : proEtaleDerivedCategory (Spec (.of T.datum.k)) T.coefficientRing) →
    T.graphPointFibre.obj N ⟶
      T.graphPointFibre.obj
        ((sfIntrinsicDerivedPullback T.coefficientRing
          (HPow.hPow (α := End (Spec (.of T.datum.k)))
            (frobeniusPointIso T.datum).hom m)).obj N)
lean.note: Definition ownership of the published plain finite point constructions only. graphPointFibre is the exact derived sections functor, and J_z is its functor composite with the recorded intrinsic pullback (written explicitly in the consumer). graphPointTransportPower is the recursive finite-coefficient iterate, including its identity/composition and localization-size helpers. No use of graphFrobenius_point_exchange or its conclusion. Existing declarations are reused per brief-stage2 §1(A), not copied or renamed.
